title: Taiwanese Student Association at CU
content_html:
The Taiwanese Student Association at CU (TSA) is a recognized student organization at the University of Colorado Boulder serving students with ties to Taiwan. The organization’s Chinese name, 科羅拉多大學波德分校台灣學生會, appears on its Instagram profile (@cuboulder.tsa), confirming its Taiwanese-language identity and community focus.

The TSA at CU is listed on the university’s official AAPI Heritage Month page (colorado.edu/studentlife/aapi) alongside other cultural and international student organizations, and appears on the BuffConnect campus engagement platform as a recognized student organization. A Facebook group (facebook.com/groups/TsaAtCuBoulder) also exists for the organization. As of the time of research, the Instagram account had 75 followers and 6 posts, suggesting a relatively early-stage or rebuilding online presence. No dedicated website, mission statement, or founding year could be confirmed from first-party sources.
